## .github/workflows/basic_python_workflow.yaml

```yaml
name: Python package

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11"]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip' # ⚡ Useful add: Caches dependencies so your workflow runs much faster

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
        # Explicitly install the tools to guarantee they are available in CI
        python -m pip install ruff pyright pytest
        # Install your package and any additional dev dependencies
        if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then python -m pip install -e .[dev]; fi

    - name: Check formatting with Ruff
      run: ruff format --check

    - name: Lint with Ruff
      run: ruff check

    - name: Type check with Pyright
      run: pyright

    - name: Test with pytest
      run: pytest
```

## pyproject.toml

```text
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0.0", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "my_package"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A Python package for numerical ocean modeling and analysis"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
authors = [
    {name = "Your Name", email = "your.email@university.edu"}
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Physics",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
]

# 📦 CORE DEPENDENCIES
# Add libraries your ocean model actually needs to run here.
# When someone installs your package, pip will automatically install these.
dependencies = [
    # "numpy>=1.24.0",
    # "scipy>=1.10.0",
    # "xarray>=2023.5.0",
    # "netcdf4>=1.6.0",
]

# 🛠️ DEVELOPMENT DEPENDENCIES
# These are only installed when you run `pip install -e .[dev]`
# It maps perfectly to your GitHub Actions workflow!
[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "ruff",
    "pyright",
    "pytest",
]

# Tells Python's build system to automatically locate your code in the src/ layout
[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

# ==============================================================================
# TOOL CONFIGURATIONS
# ==============================================================================

[tool.ruff]
# Generous line length (default is 88) to accommodate long oceanographic equations
line-length = 100

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E",   # pycodestyle errors
    "F",   # Pyflakes (unused imports, undefined variables)
    "UP",  # pyupgrade (upgrades syntax to modern Python)
    "B",   # flake8-bugbear (finds likely bugs/design issues)
    "SIM", # flake8-simplify (helps you write cleaner code)
    "I",   # isort (orders imports alphabetially)
]

[tool.pyright]
include = ["src", "analysis", "tests"]
exclude = ["**/__pycache__", "venv"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
# Tells pytest where to look for your tests automatically
testpaths = ["tests"]
```
